citations.claim: controller_force at step 1 is 250.33 > fmax 194.57, violation
initial speed large opposite desired direction creates large velocity error

counterfactual.change: Reduced kp from 26.4 to 5, which lowers velocity-error force below fmax, removing violation while keeping same steps, body, fmax, waypoint, noise.

explanation: Controller commanded force 250.34 exceeds fmax 194.57 at step 1. Body starts moving -5.84 m/s away from waypoint while vcmd 5.38 wants motion toward waypoint (12.1,8.8), so velocity error ~10 m/s times kp 26.4 produces ~264 N before clamping plus noise, exceeding fmax. Reducing kp to 5 avoids violation, showing force is computed but not effectively limited to fmax.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body sits on the left side of the arena far from the green waypoint near top-center, and stays essentially in place between step 0 and step 1. No wall penetration, tunneling, or dramatic jump is visible – the controller_force_limit violation is an internal force calculation issue not obvious from positions alone.
